question: During the reign of the Cholas, the land given for the maintenance of a school was known as _______.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Shalabhog.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The name **"Shalabhoga"** refers to** land granted **for the **upkeep of a school** in the context of tax management during the reign of the** imperial Cholas.**
 
• The land given to the** temples** is called** Tirunamattukkani.**
 
• The land provided to **Jaina institutions** is known as **Palichchandam.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brahmadeya:**

 
 
• The land given to** Brahmanas** is known as Brahmadeya.
 
 
 
• **Vellanavagai:**
 
 
• The land of** non-Brahamana peasant owners **is called Vellanavagai.
 
 
 
• **Devdan:**
 
 
• The Land given to** temples** is called Devadana.
